overview_description.description:
Intel IQ is a cybersecurity company that provides real-time dark web credential monitoring, uncovering leaked passwords & session cookies to secure your team and customers. 
 Unlike general Dark Web monitors, our narrow focus on infostealer malware logs allows us to provide more granular and actionable data - like session cookies - that general breach notification services often lack:

Proactive Threat Detection
Identify compromised employee and customer credentials from dark web stealer logs in real-time, allowing for immediate action before a breach escalates.

Real-Time Alerts
Receive immediate notifications when new data related to their domain appears on the dark web.

Session Invalidation
Use leaked session cookies to identify which active user sessions need to be terminated immediately.

Continuous Monitoring
 Strengthen your organization's cybersecurity defenses by continuously monitoring for and addressing credential compromises, reducing the risk of account takeovers and data breaches.
